008package paint.shared.validate;
009
010import com.google.gson.Gson;
011import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
012import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
013import com.google.gson.stream.JsonReader;
014import com.google.gson.stream.MalformedJsonException;
015
016import java.io.IOException;
017import java.io.Reader;
018import java.io.StringReader;
019import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
020import java.nio.file.Files;
021import java.nio.file.Path;
022import java.util.Arrays;
023
024/**
025 * Provides utility methods to validate the syntax of JSON configuration files using the Google
026 * GSON library.
027 * <p>
028 * The {@code JsonValidator} reads a JSON file and attempts to parse it to check for structural
029 * errors. If parsing fails, it generates a detailed error report including the line and column
030 * number of the failure, along with a visual snippet of the code where the error occurred.
031 * </p>
032 * <ul>
033 *   <li>Strict JSON syntax validation.</li>
034 *   <li>Contextual error reporting with line/column pointers.</li>
035 *   <li>Lightweight integration with GSON.</li>
036 * </ul>
037 */
038public final class JsonValidator {
039
040    private static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder()
041            // Strict is default; do not call setLenient(false) — method takes no args.
042            .create();
043
044    /**
045     * Represents the result of a JSON validation attempt.
046     */
047    public static final class Result {
048        /** True if the JSON is syntactically valid. */
049        public final boolean valid;
050        /** The error message if validation failed, otherwise null. */
051        public final String error;
052
053        private Result(boolean valid, String error) {
054            this.valid = valid;
055            this.error = error;
056        }
057
058        /** @return a successful validation result */
059        public static Result ok()   { return new Result(true, null); }
060
061        /**
062         * @param error the error message
063         * @return a failed validation result
064         */
065        public static Result fail(String error) { return new Result(false, error); }
066    }
067
068    /**
069     * Validates JSON syntax for the specified file.
070     *
071     * @param jsonPath path to the JSON file
072     * @return a {@link Result} indicating success or failure
073     */
074    public static Result validate(Path jsonPath) {
075        String content;
076        try {
077            content = new String(Files.readAllBytes(jsonPath), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
078        } catch (IOException e) {
079            return Result.fail("Cannot read file: " + e.getMessage());
080        }
081
082        try (Reader r = new StringReader(content)) {
083            JsonReader jr = new JsonReader(r);
084            jr.setLenient(false); // enforce strict JSON
085            JsonObject parsed = GSON.fromJson(jr, JsonObject.class);
086
087            // Gson returns null — without throwing — for input that contains no JSON at all.
088            // An empty or blank file is not a valid configuration, and reporting it as valid
089            // would mask a truncated or half-written file.
090            if (parsed == null) {
091                return Result.fail("File is empty: expected a JSON object.");
092            }
093            return Result.ok();
094        } catch (MalformedJsonException | com.google.gson.JsonSyntaxException ex) {
095            return Result.fail(buildErrorMessage(ex.getMessage(), content, jsonPath));
096        } catch (Exception ex) {
097            return Result.fail("Unexpected error while validating: " + ex.getMessage());
098        }
099    }
100
101    private static String buildErrorMessage(String msg, String content, Path path) {
102        int line = extractInt(msg, "line ", " ");
103        int col  = extractInt(msg, "column ", " ");
104
105        String context = extractContext(content, line, col);
106
107        return "Malformed JSON in '" + path.getFileName() + "'\n"
108                + "Line " + line + ", column " + col + "\n\n"
109                + context + "\n\n"
110                + "Error: " + msg;
111    }
112
113    @SuppressWarnings("SameParameterValue")
114    private static int extractInt(String msg, String key, String delim) {
115        if (msg == null) {
116            return 1;
117        }
118        int idx = msg.indexOf(key);
119        if (idx < 0) {
120            return 1;
121        }
122        idx += key.length();
123        int end = msg.indexOf(delim, idx);
124        if (end < 0) {
125            end = msg.length();
126        }
127        try {
128            return Integer.parseInt(msg.substring(idx, end).trim());
129        } catch (Exception e) {
130            return 1;
131        }
132    }
133
134    private static String extractContext(String content, int errLine, int errCol) {
135        if (content == null) {
136            return "";
137        }
138        String[] lines = content.split("\\R", -1);
139        if (errLine < 1 || errLine > lines.length) {
140            return "";
141        }
142
143        String line = lines[errLine - 1];
144
145        return String.format("%4d | %s%n", errLine, line) +
146                "     | " +
147                spaces(Math.max(0, errCol - 1)) +
148                "^";
149    }
150
151    private static String spaces(int n) {
152        char[] arr = new char[Math.max(0, n)];
153        Arrays.fill(arr, ' ');
154        return new String(arr);
155    }
156
157    private JsonValidator() {
158
159    }
160}
